time_precision: Actual final digest/receipt time recorded. Complete manual source-reading start was not separately timestamped.
independence: Reviewer did not author these six root-prepared helpers; authored loellingite and independently reviewed two phosphate owners, which does not substitute for independent review of own science.
scope: Five retained publication helpers plus optional external owned-tracking cleanup; complete source read, exact prior derivation and current preservation/profile checks. No top-level helper execution, Git/GitHub mutation, test suite or live hosted acceptance.
count_status: Configuration values observed; final whole-corpus native/coverage measurement is coordinator responsibility and is not certified by this static receipt.

checks.name: Cleanup scope
checks.detail: Requires MERGED exact topic head, clean owned checkout, live remote-main merge, exact reviewed tree and sole reviewed-base parent. Remote deletion uses exact expected-old-value lease; local deletion follows detached checkout at verified topic head. No other branch is selected.

checks.name: Original-main preservation
checks.detail: Requires clean main at exact reviewed base, postmerge receipt mode/head/tree/base/commands/log hash and live remote main. Rechecks each of7249 baseline nontracked entries by kind/mode/size/hash or symlink target, retained tag and durable backup manifest; hidden/ignored current nontracked paths are checked for incoming file or ancestor collisions before --ff-only --no-autostash. No unrelated restoration or pruning.

checks.name: Queue admission
checks.detail: Binds preflight mode and exact base/head/tree plus commands/log/counts, clean current topic, live PR/body/title/pathset, successful required checks and matching exact-head posted COMMENT, effective squash queue and immediate live main==base. Native queue plus postmerge tree/parent checks remain necessary because the last base read is not atomic locking.

checks.name: Isolated provenance verification
checks.detail: Creates only a fresh unique temporary clone; source checkout is read-only. Fetches all tags and verifies exact retained tag locally/remotely, proves topic object absent before/after checks, constructs synthetic reviewed-tree squash for preflight and requires actual remote-main tree/sole parent after merge. Record/history/native-review/coverage commands operate in fresh clone; no push or source checkout mutation.

checks.name: Exact scientific coverage
checks.detail: Filesystem enumeration includes hidden/ignored paths and follows links with cycle prevention; requires every current ID/path/hash in a completed positive scientific review and verifies all distinct reviewed bases are available commits. Dynamic finalized counts bind config; canonical review checker remains a separate required gate.

checks.name: Owned tracking-ref cleanup
checks.detail: Requires matching cleanup/head and local/remote branch-absent receipt, rechecks live remote absence, accepts only the exact owned refs/remotes/origin/<branch> at topic head, deletes with expected-old-value guard and rechecks absence. No pruning.

limitations: Runtime preflight, independent complete hosted review, queue, merge, branch cleanup, fresh-main verification and actual preservation receipts remain required.

Enqueue matching posted review lookup reads its first100 reviews. This fails closed if its exact COMMENT falls outside that page; complete conversation assessment belongs to the independent hosted review before the coordinator posts it.
Sync checks all baseline nontracked entries and collision safety, without asserting that later unrelated additional ignored files do not exist.
The original profile requires all review bases available; this static read is not an actual enumeration or successful fresh-clone gate.
No expensive tests rerun: five algorithms are exact declared predecessor substitutions and the optional tracking cleanup was only parsed/read.
